description_en: Modifies the vSwitches that are connected to elastic network interfaces (ENIs)
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-user-eni-vswitch-options --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --vswitch-options vsw-rj9ixufmywqq98z000000,vsw-rj95ij6wcz656v7000000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyUserEniVswitchOptions

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454314.html接口查看指定集群的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The vSwitches that you want to use. The vSwitches must reside in the same virtual private cloud (VPC) and zone as ENIs. You can specify up to three vSwitches. Separate multiple vSwitches with commas (,).

> 

*   The vSwitches that you specify overwrite the existing vSwitches that are connected to ENIs.

*   You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612399.html operation to query the network information about ENIs in a cluster
parameters.help_zh:
可选交换机列表。 交换机需要与ENI所属同一个VPC和可用区内，最多可填3个交换机，交换机之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> * 所填写的交换机列表将覆盖已有ENI交换机列表。
> * 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612399.html接口查看指定集群的ENI网络信息
parameters.name: vswitch_options
